reference.title: IDLE select switch
reference.shortdesc: Before operating the steering lever, push down the brake pedal and release it slowly to

li.p: The switch (1) is to activate idling and the switch (2) to control the speed of idling.

ul.li: The switch ① maintains basic condition at position ‘2’.
The switch ② maintains basic condition at position ‘2’.

li.p: Press the switch ① at ‘1’ position for 0.1 s to activate idle function.

ul.li: With the function activated, pressing the switch ② to position '1' will increase the engine idling speed from 800 rpm (baseline) up to 1300 rpm at 50 rpm steps.
Pressing the switch ② to position '3' will decrease the engine idling speed by 50 rpm steps.

ol.li: Press the switch ① at ‘1’ position for 0.1 s again to deactivate the idle function and the engine idling speed returns to 800 rpm.

section.title: Result
section.note: If the engine speed is increased with this switch, the creep speed of the lift truck will become higher than in normal mode.
section.p: Before operating the steering lever, push down the brake pedal and release it slowly to prevent accident caused by sudden movement.
